questions.stem: In the displacement reaction between iron and copper sulfate, which half-equation correctly shows what happens to the copper ions?
questions.explanation: In this displacement reaction, the copper ions (Cu²⁺) gain two electrons to form copper metal: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu. This is reduction (gain of electrons). The iron is oxidised (Fe → Fe²⁺ + 2e⁻), providing the electrons that the copper ions gain.
